quotes: assert again["changed"] is False  # A05, State 5 "Repeats"
verdicts.why: The check asserts that the repeated archive changes nothing and leaves both the exposed and stored audit log unchanged. It only checks that the answer contains no confirmation_id; because ProjectCardAnswer never carries one, it does not detect an implementation that mints and then discards a confirmation id.
